prd.title: Field Incident Detail (Karim)
prd.overview: Field Incident Detail is Karim's on-site workspace. Photo capture with auto-EXIF strip, structured diagnosis (severity / category / tags), fix submission (parts list + photo proof), and proof-of-completion flow emitting FixSubmitted in one transaction. Lifecycle actions in order: Acknowledged → TechnicianArrived → DiagnosisSubmitted → FixSubmitted. This is the load-bearing surface for Goal 1.4 (field proof < 30 min).

scope.platform: Reconcile web/src/pages/FieldIncidentDetailPage.tsx (601 LOC); photo upload via POST /api/photos; emit TechnicianArrived + FixSubmitted

requirement.title: Mount route at /field/:incident_id for field_technician
requirement.description: Register route in App.tsx wrapped in RequireSession with role guard for field_technician.

requirement.title: Header (band + reporter + due_at countdown + Mark arrived)
requirement.description: Header renders BandPill, reporter-badge chip (citizen's source), due_at countdown (if assigned), and Mark arrived button.

acceptance.criterion: Mark arrived button emits TechnicianArrived on click

requirement.title: Photo capture with auto-EXIF strip
requirement.description: Render photo capture control (camera or gallery). After selection, auto-populate EXIF strip (lat/lon/timestamp/device). All EXIF fields editable.

acceptance.criterion: Capture control opens picker (camera + gallery options)
EXIF strip auto-populates from image metadata
EXIF fields are editable (verified by DOM)

requirement.title: Structured diagnosis (severity / category / tags)
requirement.description: Diagnosis form renders structured fields: severity dropdown, category dropdown, tags input. Never single textarea; never free-form-only input. Per foundation §12 #7.

acceptance.criterion: No single textarea for diagnosis (verified by DOM inspection)

requirement.title: Fix form (parts list + photo proof)
requirement.description: Fix form renders parts list (add/remove rows) and photo proof capture (required before submit). Parts rows: part name + quantity.

acceptance.criterion: Photo proof control renders; required before submit

requirement.title: Submit proof emits FixSubmitted (single transaction)
requirement.description: Submit proof button emits POST /api/events with FixSubmitted{actor: karim, incident_id, parts, photo_hash, diagnosis} in one transaction. Button disabled until all required fields filled.

acceptance.criterion: Submit enabled when all required filled
Click emits FixSubmitted with correct payload

requirement.title: Mark arrived emits TechnicianArrived (with lat/lon)
requirement.description: Mark arrived button emits POST /api/events with TechnicianArrived{actor: karim, incident_id, lat, lon}. Captures current geolocation at click time.

requirement.title: MSW: photo upload + FixSubmitted event handler
requirement.description: Extend web/src/mocks/handlers.ts: POST /api/photos (multipart stub) returns photo_hash; POST /api/events accepts FixSubmitted event type. Photo fixture in web/src/mocks/fixtures.ts.

requirement.title: Citizen context (read-only)
requirement.description: Render citizen context panel: location hint + description (from original incident). Read-only.

acceptance.criterion: Context panel renders with location + description
No editable controls in context panel

requirement.title: Override surface (View override reasoning)
requirement.description: When chain segment contains TrustBandOverridden event, render "View override reasoning" affordance. Click expands to show the reasoning payload.

acceptance.criterion: Affordance visible when override event in segment

requirement.title: Area Labels per foundation §13
requirement.description: Implement Area Labels per foundation §13: field-incident-detail-page, …-header, …-main, …-button-mark-arrived, …-photo-capture, …-exif-strip, …-exif-lat, …-exif-lon, …-exif-timestamp, …-exif-device, …-diagnosis-form, …-severity, …-category, …-tags, …-fix-form, …-parts-list, …-parts-row, …-add-part, …-remove-part, …-fix-photo, …-button-submit-proof.

acceptance.criterion: All Area Labels present with matching id and aria-label

requirement.title: i18n keys (EN + BN)
requirement.description: Add i18n keys for page title, button labels, photo capture modes, EXIF labels, diagnosis fields, parts list labels, fix photo, submit proof, toast, override. EN + BN parity. No Hindi.

requirement.title: Reconciliation: confirm role gating + structured diagnosis
requirement.description: Verify field_technician role guard; verify diagnosis form uses structured fields (not single textarea); verify FixSubmitted single transaction.

acceptance.criterion: grep 'textarea' in DiagnosisForm returns zero hits (single textarea is forbidden)
FixSubmitted fires once per submit (no double-fire on photo upload)

prd.test-protocol:
[Added last — written when implementation is near complete]
Capture photo with EXIF; assert EXIF strip auto-populates; edit a field; assert value persists. EXIF capture + edit works.
Inspect diagnosis form DOM; assert no textarea element. Structured fields enforced.
Fill diagnosis; add parts; upload photo; click Submit; intercept POST /api/events; assert FixSubmitted with parts + photo_hash + diagnosis in payload. FixSubmitted fires correctly.
Mock geolocation; click Mark arrived; assert TechnicianArrived event with lat/lon. Geolocation captured.
